detail: Texmaco Defence Technologies Limited has secured investmests from its parent company Texmaco Rail and Engineering Limited and Vagus Def Tech & Aerospace Fund-1, the pooling vehicle of Calculus Defence Fund. Khaitan & Co advised both Texmaco Defence and Texmaco Rail on this transaction. The transaction team consisted of Shourya Sengupta (Partner), Riya Dutta (Consultant), Supallab Chakraborty (Principal Associate), Joysurjo Roy (Senior Associate) and Ishika Sinha (Associate).
